brief: BRONZE-001 r001 hafted bronze axe and knife with chop/fell motion (art/briefs/economy-batch4/BRONZE-001.md + README.md; base draft content/research/next-batch/material-culture.md §5; contract art/handoffs/bronze-bohemia-opus-v2 COMMON.md/RETURN.md, kit spec 2.0)
author: GitHub Copilot autonomous modelling agent (procedural Blender generators written for this job); character body/rig/skin/palette copied unchanged from the accepted PERSON-001 r002 return
actual_agent_model: Dispatched as the 'Opus 5.5' modeller slot (GitHub Copilot agent session, resumed after a runtime restart); the underlying model identity cannot be independently verified from inside the session
tools: Blender 5.2.3 LTS (bpy generators, Workbench stills, re-import/reopen/contact checks)
Khronos glTF Blender I/O v5.2.41 (GLB export/import)

models.role: winged bronze axe head on a knee-shaped wooden haft (R), lying on its side on the floor; haft along Z, head and edge towards +X; edge line parallel to the haft (axe, not adze)

anchor_notes.grip: dominant (right) hand grip centre on the haft, 0.14 m from the butt; local +Y = haft axis towards the head (glTF), local +Z = edge-facing direction; attach as axe_root = person.axe_hold * inverse(grip)
anchor_notes.grip_secondary: second hand, 0.05 m from the butt, same orientation as grip
anchor_notes.edge_contact: midpoint of the convex cutting edge, same orientation as grip
anchor_notes.base_center: floor origin for the resting state

models.role: broken winged head (wing/butt part + separated blade fragment) for the scrap/recycling state; bronze only, lying flat
small curved bronze knife with ring-ended tang and organic (wood/bone R) handle plates, lying flat; blade towards +Z, edge towards +X

anchor_notes.grip: handle centre; local +Y = handle axis towards the blade, local +Z = edge-facing direction

models.role: log stump (top 0.42 m) with two split pieces, one round billet and a few chips

anchor_notes.worker_origin: (0.03, 0, -0.78): person_chopping root during chop clips (worker faces +Z towards the block)

models.role: PERSON-001 r002 body/rig/skin/palette byte-identical, with six new in-place clips and one new node axe_hold under hand.R

anchor_notes.axe_hold: NEW, child of hand.R: pose of the axe grip node; axe_root = axe_hold.global * inverse(axe.grip.local)

animations.name: chop_enter
animations.first_last_pose: first = PERSON r002 idle t=0 (axe in right hand); last = chop t=0

animations.name: chop
animations.first_last_pose: first = last (periodic); t=0 axe raised over the head

animations.name: chop_exit
animations.first_last_pose: first = chop t=0; last = r002 idle t=0

animations.name: fell_enter
animations.first_last_pose: first = r002 idle t=0; last = fell t=0

animations.name: fell
animations.first_last_pose: first = last (periodic); t=0 axe drawn back over the right shoulder

animations.name: fell_exit
animations.first_last_pose: first = fell t=0; last = r002 idle t=0

kit_unique_textures.name: bronze001_atlas
kit_unique_textures.note: one shared image; each prop GLB embeds its own identical copy so it stays self-contained

character_materials_textures.note: inherited unchanged from PERSON-001 r002; not counted in the kit budget

chop_demo_instantiated.textures_note: unique images: bronze001_atlas 512^2 + person_palette 256^2; the atlas is embedded in both prop GLBs and is loaded once per GLB unless the engine deduplicates it
chop_demo_instantiated.note: person_chopping + axe_winged_hafted + chopping_block; axe_head_scrap replaces the axe in the scrap state (mutually exclusive)

exaggeration.note: no deliberate readability exaggeration; draft R/design values were head 0.16 m and edge 0.05 m (x1.03 / x1.06 from the convex-edge bulge); total axe 0.665 m within the brief's 0.6-0.7 m; knife 0.207 m (draft 0.21 m)

motion.rig: PERSON-001 r002, 23 bones, bind pose/inverse binds byte-identical
motion.import_settings_godot: person_chopping.glb: animations/chop and animations/fell settings/loop_mode=1 (LINEAR); nodes/PATH:AnimationPlayer optimizer/enabled=false (recommended; the default optimizer drops keys: see checks/godot_check_default_optimizer.json). Transition clips stay LOOP_NONE.

contact.note: the fell target is any trunk of radius ~0.2 m at 0.85 m; for VEG-001 oak_winter/summer place the oak root at worker_root * (0.36145, 0, 0.84197) (measured on the actual mesh)

deviations: Draft (material-culture.md §5) asked for axe_hafted.glb/knife.glb, a separate axe_head mesh and two knife-handle options; this job follows the batch-4 brief names and <=300-tri budget: the head is a separate material primitive (BRONZE001_bronze) inside the AXE mesh, the knife has one handle option (ring-ended tang with handle plates)
Extra anchors beyond the brief: grip_secondary and edge_contact (axe), edge_contact (knife), base_center (all props), chop_target and worker_origin (block)
Extra clips beyond chop/fell: chop_enter/chop_exit and fell_enter/fell_exit (1.0 s each) so every sequence starts and ends on the r002 idle pose
Fell clip is 1.6 s (brief gives ~1.5 s only for chop)
No fell anchor is exported on the person (the contract forbids extra non-hand nodes); the oak placement is documented here and in checks/contact_check.json
Bronze surface: one 'working bronze' material; the scrap uses a greener patina cell of the same atlas (no third material)
